content.statement: Loss of quantum coherence due to environment, described by T₁ and T₂.
content.explanation: Mechanisms: energy relaxation (T₁), dephasing (T₂), leakage. Master equation: dρ/dt = −(i/ℏ)[H,ρ] + ∑ D[L_k]ρ, where D[L]ρ = LρL† − ½{L†L, ρ}.

codeExamples.code:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
from qiskit.quantum_info import Statevector
import json

LESSON_ID = '14-14-1-decoherence'
from qiskit.quantum_info import Statevector
circuit = QuantumCircuit(1)
circuit.h(0)
ideal = Statevector.from_instruction(circuit)
print(json.dumps({'lesson': LESSON_ID, 'ideal_probabilities': [float(abs(a)**2) for a in ideal.data]}))

content.statement: Depolarizing, amplitude damping, phase damping, and thermal noise.
content.explanation: Depolarizing: random Pauli error with prob p. Amplitude damping: energy relaxation (spontaneous emission). Phase damping: loss of phase info. Thermal noise: finite temperature effects.
keyTakeaways: Depolarizing, amplitude damping, phase damping, and thermal noise.

content.statement: Readout error modeled by assignment probabilities.
content.explanation: P(read 0|state 0) = 1−ε₀, P(read 1|state 1) = 1−ε₁. Calibrated by measuring known states.
keyTakeaways: Readout error modeled by assignment probabilities.

steps.text: Write |ψ⟩ = Σ_i c_i|i⟩ in the orthonormal eigenbasis of the observable.

steps.title: Project onto outcome i
steps.text: Orthogonality isolates the amplitude associated with outcome i.

steps.text: Squaring the modulus gives the probability of observing outcome i.

content.statement: Zero-Noise Extrapolation (ZNE), Probabilistic Error Cancellation (PEC), Dynamical Decoupling (DD).
content.explanation: ZNE: run at different noise levels and extrapolate to zero. PEC: represent ideal operation as linear combination of noisy ops; cost exponential overhead. DD: apply pulses to average out noise (Hahn echo, CPMG, XY4).
keyTakeaways: Zero-Noise Extrapolation (ZNE), Probabilistic Error Cancellation (PEC), Dynamical Decoupling (DD).
